IFRA
STANDARD
Example Solvent
 2004 (Amendment 38) 1/2
IFRA STANDARD

CAS-No.: 111-11-1
The scope of this Standard includes, but is not limited to the CAS number(s) indicated
above; any other CAS number(s) used to identify this fragrance ingredient should be
considered in scope as well.
Synonyms: Example synonym

History: Publication date: 2004 (Amendment 38)

Previous
Publications:
1990

For new creation*: Not applicable.
For existing creation*: Not applicable.
Implementation
dates:
*These dates apply to the supply of fragrance mixtures (formulas) only, not to the
finished consumer products in the marketplace.

RECOMMENDATION: PROHIBITION / SPECIFICATION

FRAGRANCE INGREDIENT PROHIBITION: Example Solvent should not be used as a
fragrance ingredient.

FRAGRANCE INGREDIENT SPECIFICATION: The level of Example Solvent has to be
kept as low as practicable and should never
exceed 1 ppm in the fragrance compound.

CONTRIBUTIONS FROM OTHER SOURCES: NONE TO CONSIDER BEYOND TRACES
